# N8 — Power calculation (generated by `power_n8.py`)

Control (F1): 22 of 64 died out (m = 0.344). Sham vs control: 18 of 64 worlds changed fate (discordance 0.281); HB1's and MC1's shams identical: yes.
Fitted spread of world-level extinction probability: Beta(a = 0.569, b = 1.086).
F2's effect (perfect partner finding): extinction 7 of 64, a relative reduction e = 0.68.

Power (share of 20,000 simulated experiments with sign-test p < 0.05 and fewer extinctions in the treatment):

| worlds | e = F2's (0.68) | half of F2's | a third of F2's |
|---|---|---|---|
| 64 | 0.93 | 0.32 | 0.15 |
| 128 | 1.00 | 0.63 | 0.31 |
| 192 | 1.00 | 0.83 | 0.46 |
| 256 | 1.00 | 0.92 | 0.60 |

Check: with e = 0 the same procedure gives the test's false-positive rate in the 'fewer' direction:
64 worlds, e = 0: 0.015 (should be at most about 0.025).
